verdicts.label: Verifiable Digital Health Certificate
verdicts.msgid: The core functionality is the secure and trusted exchange of signature keys for GDHCN Trust Network Gateway (TNG) which acts as a central repository for the public keys. GDHCN Participants are empowered to publish the public keys that they use to sign Verifiable Digital Health Certificate. Relying GDHCN Participants can use the TNG to fetch up-to-date public key material on a timely basis.
verdicts.reason: The sentence uses the plural; Arabic renders it الشهادات الصحية الرقمية القابلة للتحقق, the fixed term's broken plural, which the stem matcher cannot see.
